correctness.rationale: For D=diag(a,b), D_prime=JDJ, M(p)=[[1-p,hp],[hp,1-p]], monodromy equals (JMD)^2. The nonnegative matrix JMD gives Perron multiplier G(p)=[hp(a+b)+sqrt(h^2p^2(a-b)^2+4ab(1-p)^2)]/2. Its second derivative equals AB/[2Q^(3/2)]>0 for A=h^2(a-b)^2 and B=4ab. Thus only endpoint maximizers, switch h=sqrt(b/a), and derivative-at-zero threshold 2sqrt(ab)/(a+b), with a unique interior minimum below the local boundary. At the rational rescue witness G(0)<1<G(1), unique root follows from strict convexity and the explicit characteristic equation. Exact symbolic and rational independent checks agree; these do not replace the analytic proof.
